new_events.summary: Saudi state reporting described a new attack and fire on the East-West pipeline in western Madinah region. Authorities reported fire extinguished, no injuries and no operational disruption; attribution and exact strike location unresolved. Treat reported outcomes as authority claims pending independent confirmation.
